the console too much day break.
Every surface tells reporting every shadow files a claim.
Tiny errors turn fluorescent with my number and my name.
I can sort the room in pieces, I can hear the suckets blink, but the more the circuit
flatters the less room I have to think.
There is no clean invitation, only doors that talk too fast, only mirrors, checking
mirrors only proof that doesn't last.
Catch the spike, hold the light, call it signal, call it right.
Be cold circuit, don't let go, catch the spike and make you grow.
Every breath becomes a test, every kind of sounds a step slightly, a little
dinging useless crown, run me, and grind me down, if this signal got the feet, I don't want what it does to me.
